name: Death Note: Killer Within
summary: Among Us-style social deduction where Team Kira tries to kill with the Death Note while Team L tries to find and destroy it.
rules_text: Up to 10 players are secretly assigned to two opposing factions: Kira and his followers versus L and the investigation team, with special roles like Mello, Watari and Soichiro added later. Play alternates between an Action Phase and a Meeting Phase. In the Action Phase players move as pawn avatars, complete tasks, search for clues and Kira attempts to secretly obtain and use the Death Note to eliminate targets. In the Meeting Phase all players discuss, share deductions and vote on suspicions. Kira's team wins if they kill all required targets. L's team wins if they identify Kira, seize the Death Note and dispose of it. If a key role leaves the match can end early.
rating_reason: Social deduction team game with hidden identities, Kira vs L.
